title: Chart Values
description: Two parts: the chart's own image references, and the nodeRemediation block of the platform values, which the platform forwards whole to this chart and to node-remediation-config. The block is typed here exactly as there, the keys only the configuration chart reads included, so a wrong kind is refused by both charts under the same path. Keys outside this list are allowed at the top level only: the platform adds its own there for every release.

image.description: Image reference, written by the package's image target.
Image reference, written by the package's image target.

agent.description: The fence agent. Safety-mode verifies the system identity over Redfish, so only fence_redfish exists.

unhealthyAfter.description: How long a node stays Ready=Unknown before it is remediated, as a Go duration of hours, minutes and seconds.

remediateNotReady.description: Remediate Ready=False as well. A boolean, not the word in quotes.

workerMinHealthy.description: Workers that must stay healthy for a worker to be remediated: a count as an integer, or a percentage string up to 100%.

stormCooldown.description: How long NodeHealthCheck waits after a storm before it remediates again, as a Go duration.

paused.description: Start no new remediation. A boolean, not the word in quotes.

bmc.description: The BMCs: the CA they present, the credentials Secret, the ComputerSystem and the port shared by every node, and one entry per Node name.

caBundle.description: PEM CA certificate(s) the BMCs present on their Redfish endpoint.

credentialsSecretName.description: Secret in the BMC namespace with username and password for every node without its own, a DNS-1123 subdomain name.

systemsUri.description: The Redfish ComputerSystem member, /redfish/v1/Systems/<id>, for every node without its own.

port.description: The Redfish HTTPS port when it is not 443, as an integer or a string of digits without a leading zero.

nodes.description: One entry per Node name, each with the BMC address and optional overrides.

address.description: The BMC host or IP, without scheme, port or path.

port.description: This node's Redfish HTTPS port, overriding bmc.port.

systemsUri.description: This node's ComputerSystem member, overriding bmc.systemsUri.

credentialsSecretName.description: This node's own credentials Secret, instead of bmc.credentialsSecretName, a DNS-1123 subdomain name.
